response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT s.transref AS transaction_reference, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), comparisons AS (SELECT *, avg_short_interest / NULLIF(AVG(avg_short_interest) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages) SELECT transaction_reference, order_type_mix, avg_short_interest, avg_option_volume_ratio, short_interest_ratio FROM comparisons ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
